rows.text: TUV NORD provide independent assurance on GULF’s sustainability information, its Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) data (hereinafter ‘the Report’), for the applied reporting period for the calendar year 2023.
rows.source_sentence: TUV NORD provide independent assurance on GULF’s sustainability information, its Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) data (hereinafter ‘the Report’), for the applied reporting period for the calendar year 2023.

rows.text: The Report covers GULF’s Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) data for the period 1st January 2023 to 31st December 2023.
rows.source_sentence: The Report covers GULF’s Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) data for the period 1st January 2023 to 31st December 2023.

rows.text: Scope, Boundary and Limitations of Assurance The scope of the assurance includes the Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) indicators in the report as per the specify disclosures required by GRI.
rows.source_sentence: Scope, Boundary and Limitations of Assurance The scope of the assurance includes the Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) indicators in the report as per the specify disclosures required by GRI.

rows.text: In particular, the assurance engagement includes the following: • Verification of the reliability of the GRI Standards Disclosure on the Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) indicators • Other relevant rules, including the host country legislation and sustainability criteria.
rows.source_sentence: In particular, the assurance engagement includes the following: • Verification of the reliability of the GRI Standards Disclosure on the Safety, Health and Environmental (SH&E) indicators • Other relevant rules, including the host country legislation and sustainability criteria.
